# unifi_dpi_applications (Data Source)

Lists the DPI (deep packet inspection) application catalog via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Read-only and site-independent. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the DPI application catalog (Official API, site-independent).
data "unifi_dpi_applications" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) An optional Official-API filter expression applied server-side when listing DPI applications.

### Read-Only

- `applications` (Attributes List) The DPI applications. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applications))

<a id="nestedatt--applications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `applications`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) The numeric id of the DPI application.
- `name` (String) The name of the DPI application.
